strings.…무슨 하실 말씀이 있어서 절 부르신 거죠?: ...What did you want to tell me?
strings.걱정이 가득한 표정이군. 약속대로 네가 바이스를 만났단 이야기는 아무에게: You look worried. As promised, I haven't told anyone you met Weiss.
strings.다만, 검신께서는 알고 계신 듯했다. 혼잣말로 네가 벌써 셋의 흔적을: The Sword Master seems to know, though. I heard him remark to himself that you've already obtained traces of three Champions' power...
strings.초인들은 뭔가 느꼈나 보군요. 타르타로스의 샤이닉 님도, 칼리의 메디아: The Champions must have sensed something. Shynic in Tartaros and Medea in Kali both spoke as if they already knew...
strings.지스카드 님을 언제 뵐 수 있을까요? 힘의 흔적을 받아야 할 것 같은데…: When can I see Ziskad? I think I need to receive a trace of his power...
strings.아마도 조만간 널 부르실 것 같다. 조금만 기다려다오. 지금 검신께서는: He'll probably summon you soon. Please wait a little longer. The Sword Master is away investigating something at the moment.
I suppose it can't be helped...
strings.(그러고 보니 이리스가 보이지 않네. 루맨으로 자주 찾아오지 말라고 했지: (Come to think of it, Iris isn't here. She did tell me not to visit Lumen too often...)
strings.이리스 님은 지금 이곳에 안 계신다. 요즘엔 환영의 독안개 늪지에 들어가: Lady Iris isn't here right now. Lately, she's been spending most of her time in the Illusory Poison Mist Swamp.
I feel like you just read my mind.
Enough of that. Let's get to the point.
strings.검신께서 너를 만나기 전에 필요한 게 있으시다고 한다. 물건을 몇 개 구: The Sword Master needs a few things before he meets you. I want you to obtain them.
Probably. Before accepting someone, the Sword Master judges their potential. His disciples and I all went through the same process.
strings.타르타로스의 초인기념관에서 마석을 찾는대로 그곳에 있는 마법사에게 맡겨달: Find magic stones in Tartaros's Hall of Heroes and leave them with the mage there. He needs two.
strings.그러고 보니 초인기념관을 장악했던 란다인이란 자를 네가 쓰러뜨렸지?: You defeated Randine, the man who took over the Hall of Heroes, didn't you?
strings.네가 그를 쓰러뜨렸다 해서 찾을 수 없을 거로 생각하진 않는다. 검신께서: I don't think that means you won't be able to find them. The Sword Master says you can see places hidden from sight...
Hmm. I'm not sure I understand, but I'll manage somehow.
strings.(굳이 비밀로 하지 않아도 다들 나에 대해 아는군….): (There's no point keeping secrets when everyone already knows about me...)
strings.물건을 맡긴 후에 또 뭐가 있나요?: Is there anything else after I deliver them?
The mage will explain. That's all I know...
Doesn't notice when someone arrives, again. It's hardly the first time...
strings.이게 란다인이란 자를 세뇌시킨 그 마석이군요. 이미 효력은 다 했겠지만…: So these are the magic stones that brainwashed Randine. Their effects have surely worn off by now...
In any case, I'll analyze them as the Alliance requested.
strings.물어볼 게 있어요. 이 마석을 분석하면 어떤 정보를 얻을 수 있나요?: There's something I want to ask. What can you learn by analyzing these magic stones?
strings.데이모스 교단에서 만들어진 마석을 분석하는 분들이 많은 거로 알고 있어요: I know lots of people are studying the Deimos cult's magic stones. But no one seems to have come up with a proper answer.
strings.저희는 저희대로, 그들은 그들대로 분석해 나름대로 각자 세력에서 활용할: We conduct our analyses, and they conduct theirs. Each faction will put its findings to use in its own way.
strings.제대로 된 답이 나오지 않는 것은…. 데이모스 교단에서 만든 마석이 점점: The reason we lack a definitive answer is... The magic stones made by the Deimos cult keep evolving into different forms.
strings.생명의 힘을 추출해 만들고, 또 다른 생명을 세뇌하는 패턴이었다면, 최근: Previously, they were made by extracting life force and used to brainwash other living beings. Recently, we've found some things that are hard to believe.
Please understand that I can't explain properly until we're certain.
I know how difficult your work is, Adventurer, but...
strings.자신을 잃지 않았으면 좋겠습니다. 비록 사람을 상대하는 스킬이 부족한 마: I hope you don't lose sight of yourself. This may be coming from a mage with poor people skills, but I don't think it's bad advice.
strings.고마워요, 펄스. 그럼 이제 무슨 일을 하면 될까요?: Thank you, Pulse. What should I do next?
strings.어디서 구할 수 있는 건지는 모르겠지만, 환영 나무의 씨앗이란 걸 구해서: I don't know where to find them, but please obtain some Illusion Tree Seeds and give them to someone named Tia in the Amaloon Desert. About fifty should do.
strings.사막에 심을 건가…?: Is she going to plant them in the desert...?
strings.그건 저도 모르겠습니다만…. 그건 그분만 아시겠죠. 그럼 전 연구를 위해: I couldn't say... Only she knows. Now, I must return to my research...
Whew... Illusion Tree Seeds. Back to Lapier, then.
Hello, Adventurer. It's good to see you.
Here are the things you requested...
I was waiting for something Yuran said she would send from Lumen. So this is it.
strings.루맨에서도, 인근 쥬드 왕국에서도 제가 여기 머물러도 된다고 하셔서 조금: Both Lumen and the neighboring Kingdom of Jude have allowed me to stay here, so I wanted to make a few improvements.
strings.모험가님, 이 씨앗의 이름은 무엇인가요?: Adventurer, what are these seeds called?
strings.환영 나무의 씨앗이라고 해요. 성스러운 땅에서만 자라는 나무에서 나온 거: Illusion Tree Seeds. They come from trees that only grow on sacred ground.
Sacred creatures called phantom beasts carry and scatter these special seeds.
How fascinating. That reminds me of my little ones...
Exactly. Maybe that's why they all dislike me and keep biting me.
strings.그게 사랑받고 있다는 증거랍니다. 이 씨앗에서…. 특별한 분의 느낌이 드: That's proof they love you. These seeds... I can sense someone extraordinary in them. Have you met a new god?
strings.(티야에게 그동안 있었던 일을 간단하게 설명한다.): (You briefly explain what has happened to Tia.)
strings.이 땅의 대지를 만드신 신…. 그분께서도 많은 일을 겪으셨군요. 모험가님: The god who created the land of this world... They have been through much. And so have you, Adventurer...
strings.그리고 힘을 탐한 그들의 최후는 제 동생과 비슷하게 됐군요…. 어찌 보면: And those who coveted power met an end much like my younger sibling's... Perhaps that was inevitable...
strings.혹시 더 부탁하실 일이 있나요? 무슨 물건을 구해서 어디 가야 한다거나…: Do you need anything else? Something I should find and take somewhere...?
strings.아니요. 저는 그런 건 없답니다. 그냥 루맨으로 돌아가셔서 유란 님의 이: No, nothing like that. I think you should simply return to Lumen and hear what Yuran has to say.
strings.(그럼 유란이 무슨 이야기를 하려나….): (I wonder what Yuran wants to tell me...)
You've been busy. It feels like a long time since I last saw you.
I know you've encountered various strange phenomena and met Weiss. Thank you for helping with matters in the Amaloon Desert, too.
strings.매번 많은 도움을 받았습니다. 다시 한번 연합의 일원으로서 감사 인사드립: You've helped us so often. As a member of the Alliance, I thank you once again.
strings.(나를 대하는 태도가 달라진 것 같은데….): (She seems to be treating me differently...)
strings.의심하지 않으셔도 됩니다. 저는 연합의 일원으로, 스승님의 제자로 말씀드: You needn't be suspicious. I speak as a member of the Alliance and a disciple of my master...
And thank you, as always, for looking after Ull.
I don't see Ull here. Off training again, I take it?
strings.네, 그 아이는 그렇지요…. 인사는 이쯤에서 하고, 스승님께서 전해 달라: Yes. That's how he is... Enough pleasantries. My master left a message for you.
He asks you to wait. He'll speak to you about a certain relic soon.
strings.저는 그 유물이 뭔지 잘 모르겠습니다만, 조만간 저희 연합에 중요한 일에: I don't know what it is, but it seems it will soon serve an important purpose for our Alliance.
strings.그렇군요. 어, 그런데 사람들이 많이 있네요. 무슨 일이 있나요?: I see. Oh, there are a lot of people here. Is something happening?
strings.이번에 모스 왕국을 토벌하면서 프레이오스 대륙의 실바리아 제국과의 교류를: Following the campaign against the Kingdom of Moss, we agreed to expand our ties with the Silvaria Empire in Freios.
strings.그래서 실바리아 제국의 일부 일원이 아직 남아 일을 보고 있습니다. 포보: Some members of the Silvaria Empire have stayed behind to attend to business. Phobos isn't too pleased about it, though.
strings.이스트랜드 북서쪽에 있는 작은 도시입니다. 멀리 떨어진 곳이라 교류는 적: A small city in northwestern Eastland. We have little contact because it's so far away, but the Deimos cult has less influence there.
strings.때가 되면 가실지도 모르겠습니다. 근처에 흉왕이 머물고 있다는 이야기도: You may visit when the time comes. We've heard the Fierce King is staying nearby.
%s, come over here. I still have something to tell you.
Adventurer, I have work to do, so I'll excuse myself. Please speak with Jin.
You handled the Sword Master's requests well. Thank you.
It's nothing... What did you want to tell me?
strings.실바리아 제국 측에서 마라의 발언을 토대로 어느 정도 수사를 진행한 것: It seems the Silvaria Empire has made progress in its investigation based on Mara's testimony.
strings.마라를 심문하던 중에 이런 이야기가 나왔어. 마라가 자신을 가짜로 인정했: This came up during her interrogation: Mara admitted she was a fake.
strings.가짜 아가슈라…. 확실히 이상하긴 했죠. 아가슈라만의 왕국을 만들기 위해: A fake Agasura... It was strange, certainly. Joining forces with the Kingdom of Moss and wreaking havoc everywhere to build a kingdom for Agasuras...
At least, that's not how the Agasuras I know behave.
strings.그래. 일반적인 아가슈라는 마석을 들고 설치진 않으니까. 그럼 이어서 말: Exactly. Ordinary Agasuras don't run around causing trouble with magic stones. I'll continue.
strings.반과 마라는 바이스에게 마석을 만드는 힘을 받았고, 그걸로 자신들을 아가: Ban and Mara received the power to make magic stones from Weiss. That led them to believe they were Agasuras.
strings.이건 마라가 직접 실바리아 제국에 말한 사실이다. 일부 내용은 우리 쪽과: Mara told the Silvaria Empire this herself. Some of the information was shared with us.
strings.마라는 반이 바이스에게 죽었다고 이야기했다. 하지만, 그곳에 있던 너에: She said Weiss killed Ban. But she seemed to have forgotten that you were there.
Possibly. It was probably an Agasura's contract...
So you knew they were fakes...
strings.마라가 전부 다 이야기했다. 바이스는 그 사실조차 말하지 않게 기억을 조: Mara told them everything. Weiss could have altered her memories to keep even that secret, but he didn't.
strings.하여튼, 반과 마라가 하던 짓은 바이스를 비롯해 데이모스 교단이 하던 짓: In any case, what Ban and Mara were doing was no different from Weiss and the Deimos cult's activities. You already know that, I'm sure.
strings.그동안 많은 증거를 바탕으로 의심스러웠던 부분들이 정리됐다. 마석의 힘,: The evidence we've gathered has cleared up many of our suspicions. The power of the magic stones—or, more precisely, the power Weiss has been gathering...
It's all heading toward Avalon. The place everyone in Eastland curses...
strings.(아발론이면 데미갓 프로즌이 갔다고 한 곳이었지…. 데이모스 암흑 성국의: (Avalon is where Frozen, the Demigod, said he'd gone... The capital of the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos...)
One day, you and all of us may have to go there.
strings.루맨보다 좀 더 북쪽에 있다. 덕분에 큰 짐을 덜게 됐다. 이제 남은 건: Farther north than Lumen. This has lifted a great burden from us. All that remains now is them and the fiends of the Demon Realm...
The fakes have done so much damage to this land.
It isn't over yet. We'll keep working until then. We'll be counting on you...
And I'll be counting on you. I'll go take care of the rest of my business now.
